name: cloudmind
description: XMind-style mind maps for Obsidian, stored as plain Markdown.

scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.test:md: esbuild test/roundtrip.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=test/.out.cjs --log-level=error && node test/.out.cjs && esbuild test/contrast.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=test/.contrast.cjs --log-level=error && node test/.contrast.cjs
scripts.test:ui: esbuild test/harness.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=test/harness.js --alias:obsidian=./test/obsidian-stub.ts --main-fields=module,main --loader:.json=json --log-level=error && node test/make-html.mjs && node test/smoke.mjs && node test/idle.mjs && node test/ui.mjs && node test/wiki.mjs && node test/wheel.mjs && node test/theme.mjs && node test/drag.mjs
scripts.lint:review: node tools/obsidian-review/node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js -c tools/obsidian-review/eslint.config.mjs src manifest.json package.json LICENSE
scripts.test: npm run test:md && npm run test:ui
